name: Dex5-1
summary: Dex5-1 is Unitree's five-finger dexterous hand with 20 total degrees of freedom, including 16 active axes and four coupled finger joints. Backdrivable joints, independently replaceable fingers and lateral finger movement support manipulation and reinforcement-learning development. The official table lists a 1.1 kg mass and USB 2.0 communication, with feedback on joint motion, torque, temperature and electrical state. The base Dex5-1 does not include the pressure-sensor array listed for Dex5-1P. Manufacturer performance figures depend on the stated grasp conditions and hardware configuration.
